verses.commentary: Hear the word of the Lord. The lawsuit begins. God brings charges against Israel. No faithfulness, no love, no acknowledgment of God. The three essentials missing. The land is spiritually empty.
Only cursing, lying, murder, stealing, adultery. The opposite of covenant life. They break all bounds. No restraint. Bloodshed follows bloodshed. Violence cascades.
The land mourns. Creation suffers human sin. Beasts, birds, fish swept away. Ecological disaster as moral consequence. The earth cannot bear covenant violation.

Let no one accuse another. The people blame each other. But your people are like those who accuse a priest. The problem is systemic. Even challenging religious leadership is futile when leadership is corrupt.
You stumble day and night. Constant failure. Prophets stumble with you. Even the guides are lost. I will destroy your mother. The nation itself will fall.

My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. The famous indictment. Not lack of information but rejection of it. Because you rejected knowledge, I reject you as priests. The teaching class failed to teach. I will ignore your children. Generational consequences.
The more priests there were, the more they sinned. Numbers increased corruption. They exchanged their Glory for something disgraceful. The true God traded for idols.
They feed on the sins of my people. Priests profit from sin offerings. More sin means more offerings. They relish wickedness. Institutional incentive for evil.
Like people, like priests. No moral distinction between leaders and led. Both will be punished. Both will be repaid. Shared guilt, shared judgment.
They will eat but not be satisfied. Futility curses. Prostitution without increase. Desertion of the Lord brings emptiness in everything.
Prostitution, old wine, new wine. Physical and spiritual intoxication together. Take away understanding. Addiction clouds judgment.
My people consult a wooden idol. They ask wood for guidance. A diviner's rod speaks to them. Spirit of prostitution leads them astray. They are unfaithful to their God. The core problem restated.

They sacrifice on the mountaintops. High place worship. Oak, poplar, terebinth. Sacred trees. The shade is pleasant. Comfortable idolatry. Therefore daughters turn to prostitution. The parents' spiritual adultery produces literal immorality in the next generation.
I will not punish your daughters. Shocking reversal. The men consort with harlots, sacrifice with shrine prostitutes. Male guilt precedes female. A people without understanding will come to ruin.

Though Israel commits adultery, let Judah not become guilty. Warning to the southern kingdom. Avoid Gilgal and Beth-aven (house of wickedness, a mocking name for Bethel). Do not swear by the Lord's name. Religious speech from idolatrous hearts.
Israel is stubborn like a stubborn heifer. Unmanageable. How can the Lord pasture them like lambs? They resist the shepherd. Self-will prevents care.
Ephraim is joined to idols. Spiritual marriage to false gods. Leave him alone! God commands abandonment. Sometimes judgment is withdrawal.
Even when their drinks are gone. Drunk and empty, they continue prostitution. Rulers love shameful ways. Leadership embraces disgrace.
A whirlwind will sweep them away. Sudden, violent removal. Their sacrifices will bring them shame. What they trusted will embarrass them.
